label: Lobby
description: Lobby instance plugin — auto-redirects players from a lobby server to the right destination match server.

commands.name: go
commands.description: Redirects you to a destination server (or the assigned one if no slug given).

commands.name: lobbyset
commands.description: Assigns a player to a specific destination server.

commands.name: lobbyclear
commands.description: Clears a player's (or everyone's) destination assignment.

commands.name: lobbysend
commands.description: Immediately redirects a player to a destination server.

commands.name: lobbynotify
commands.description: Debug — re-checks pending redirect/notify data for all connected players.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns lobby redirect behaviour on or off.

cvars.label: Public Host
cvars.description: Public hostname/IP players are told to connect to.

cvars.label: Destinations
cvars.description: Configured destination servers (slug list) players can be sent to.

cvars.label: Default Destination
cvars.description: Slug of the destination server used when none is assigned.

cvars.label: Redirect Delay (s)
cvars.description: Seconds to wait before auto-redirecting a player.

cvars.label: Force Spectator
cvars.description: Forces players into spectator while in the lobby.

cvars.label: Stay-In-Lobby Permission
cvars.description: Minimum permission level allowed to stay in the lobby without being redirected.

cvars.label: Connect Message
cvars.description: Extra message shown to a player on connecting to the lobby.

cvars.label: Try Steam Open Connect
cvars.description: Attempts a Steam-open connect flow when redirecting.

cvars.label: Instances JSON
cvars.description: Path to a JSON file describing available destination instances.

cvars.label: Hub Notify Delay (s)
cvars.description: Seconds before notifying the Hub of a pending tournament match.

cvars.label: Hub Notify Countdown
cvars.description: Shows a countdown message before the Hub notify fires.
